description: This line plot illustrates the Mean Interclass Similarity across different configurations of relation extraction methods, with the x-axis representing an unlabeled discrete index ranging from 0 to 60, and the y-axis representing Mean Interclass Similarity on a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.5. The plot displays six distinct lines: a solid blue line with circular markers for “w/o DPO obo”; an orange line with triangular markers for “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”; a green line with square markers for “DPO”; a dashed blue line for “Average of w/o DPO obo”; a dotted orange line for “Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”; and a dashed green line for “Average of DPO”. The solid blue line starts at approximately 0.22 and exhibits significant fluctuations, peaking at 0.49 near x=0 and declining to around 0.02 near x=60. The orange line begins at 0.158 and fluctuates with peaks reaching up to 0.42 near x=30 and 0.41 near x=40 before declining. The green line starts at 0.158 and generally fluctuates between approximately 0.02 and 0.18. The dashed blue line remains relatively stable around 0.107, the dotted orange line remains around 0.107, and the dashed green line remains around 0.086. Three horizontal dashed lines are present at y=0.158, y=0.107, and y=0.086, corresponding to the initial values of the respective data series.
